content: Table 5 presents the results of LSTM-CRF-Pattern model trained on the reannotated difficult subset and the random subset. The first two rows show the results for models trained with expert annotations. The model trained on random data has a slightly better F1 than that trained on the same amount of difficult data. The model trained on random data has higher precision but lower recall.
